entities.name: Split–Sinj railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Sinjska rera was a narrow-gauge railway that operated between the Croatian cities of Sinj and Split from 1903 to 1962. It was an economic and social link between the Cetinska Krajina region in Dalmatian Hinterland and the largest Croatian city in the south.
